event_name: Time 17:55 2018 ITALIAN GRAND PRIX 30 August - 02 September 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (documents 22 & 23) and heard the driver and team representatives, have considered the following matter and determine the
fact: Incident between cars 14 and 20 in Turn 1.
offence: Alleged Breach of Article 31.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video, positioning data and telemetry evidence, heard from the driver of car 14 (Fernando Alonso), the driver of car 20 (Kevin Magnussen) and the team representatives. The Stewards determined that the incident between Car 14 and Car 20 at turn one did not specifically constitute unnecessary impeding by either driver, notwithstanding the fact that both drivers lost their lap.
rules_referenced: Article 31.5 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Doc 26 2018 Italian Grand Prix Decision Car 14 Incident With Car 20 In Turn 1
to: The Team Manager, McLaren F1 Team
